plan.focus_en: 了 for a change of state (生气了, 不生气了), and time words 上午 and 一会儿.

items.title_en: Read and read aloud: 妹妹生气了

translations: Today my little sister and I were at home. She's five. I was reading and she was playing.
She was running all over the place, and the water from the cup ended up on the floor.
I said: “Stop running!” She got cross and stopped talking to me.
So I sang to her. I sang her favourite song. She sang along with me.
She laughed and wasn’t cross any more. I laughed too.

glossary.english: on the floor; on the ground

translations: At ten this morning I had to meet a man to talk about money.
I opened my laptop on the bus and prepared for a while.
There was lots of traffic on the way, and the bus was slow. I thought: will I be late?
In the end I arrived at ten to ten. He hadn't even arrived yet!
We talked for an hour. He said: “OK, I understand. Let’s do it together!” I was really happy.

glossary.english: on the bus; in the car

missions.title: Taking the bus to the station
missions.goal: Check the bus goes to the train station, ask how long it takes and ask the driver to tell you when to get off.

steps.partner_en: It's crowded on the bus — move down inside.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if this bus goes to the train station.
answers_en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the train station?
Does it go to the train station?

steps.prompt_en: Ask the driver to tell you when you get there.
answers_en: Could you tell me when we get there?
Could you give me a shout when we arrive?

steps.partner_zh: 好，你坐一会儿，到了我叫你。
steps.partner_en: OK, have a seat for a bit — I'll call you when we're there.

missions.title: An annoyed flatmate
missions.goal: Apologise to your flatmate for the water on the floor, calm them down and offer to cook dinner.

steps.partner_en: Look, there's water all over the floor!
steps.prompt_en: Say sorry, you'll clean it up now.
answers_en: Sorry, I'll clean it up straight away.
Sorry, I'll wipe it up now.

steps.prompt_en: Say don't be cross, it won't happen again.
answers_en: Don't be cross — it won't happen again.
Don't be annoyed, I'll be careful next time.

steps.prompt_en: Say yes, and you'll cook for them too.
answers_en: Yes, I'll make some for you too.

steps.partner_en: OK, then I'm not cross any more.
